description: A ages 4–5 Montessori-inspired creative activities invitation focused on pattern weaving. The child can explore through real materials, conversation, and unhurried repetition.
instructions: Explore a familiar room or outdoor space. Invite the child to find examples and describe one feature at a time.
Invite the child to design pattern weaving. Offer help only when asked and allow another attempt.
Pause together and talk about what was noticed; finish by returning materials to their place.
objective: Explore materials, make choices, and express an original idea.

questions.prompt: What do you notice about pattern weaving?
choices: something the child would like to explore next

completionCriteria: Find two examples and name a feature they share.
accessibility: Offer spoken or picture instructions
Allow pointing, speech, or gesture as a response
Use large, high-contrast materials when helpful
